issues.title: Ingest Lafayette County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $8,165,156 across 34 funds. The largest: County General ($2,115,183), County Road Fund ($2,112,790), Jail Operation and Maintenance ($1,300,173). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County General
issues.detail: Printed total is $2,115,183.27; the departments listed add to $1,546,976.07. The Sheriff's office line items are not in the filed copy (the page after the Sheriff's staff list is missing), so $568,207.20 is not shown by department. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
